rows.source: Chooses eligible sibling accounts within the same provider and credential tier. A compatible, unexpired lease from a successful request takes priority for every policy; it does not guarantee a cache hit. Reset soonest prefers the nearest weekly refill, then the five-hour refill within one-minute ties. An explicit policy overrides the legacy usage-aware account pick setting.
rows.target: 在同一提供商、同一凭据层级内选择符合条件的账户。对于所有策略，成功请求留下的兼容且未过期的租约均优先；这并不保证缓存命中。“最早重置”优先选择每周额度最早补充的账户，时间相差不超过一分钟时，再比较五小时额度的补充时间。显式指定的策略优先于旧版按用量选账户设置。

rows.source: Prefer the nearest included-plan reset; spread ties and unknown reports deterministically. Default for new configurations.
rows.target: 优先选择套餐内额度最早重置的账户；时间相同或用量报告未知时，按确定性规则分散选择。新配置默认采用此策略。

rows.source: Prefer cached remaining quota, spreading accounts within ten percentage points of the best.
rows.target: 优先依据缓存的剩余额度选择账户，并在与最高剩余额度相差不超过十个百分点的账户间分散选择。

rows.source: Use a stable session-based spread instead of ranking cached resets or remaining quota.
rows.target: 按会话稳定地分散选择账户，而非依据缓存的重置时间或剩余额度排序。

rows.source: Compatibility setting, used only when account selection policy is absent: true selects Most headroom; false selects Fair spread. An explicit account selection policy takes precedence. Reset the account selection policy row to restore Reset soonest and clear legacy overrides.
rows.target: 兼容性设置，仅在未设置账户选择策略时使用：true选择“剩余额度最多”，false选择“均衡分配”。显式指定的账户选择策略优先。重置账户选择策略这一项，可恢复“最早重置”并清除旧版覆盖设置。
